answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral in escrow, and cryptographically linked equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers a penalty proportional to k², rather than k independent fees. Detection also applies asymmetric, compounding depreciation to the swarm’s remaining stake, creating an exponential multiplier in total capital loss; splitting control among identities therefore cannot cheaply evade accountability, whether their labels are saffron, tundra, or jetty.
